corePattern: Registry-First Architecture: Tokens → Taxonomy → Recipes → VPB → Renderers

criticalRules.tokensSSOT: tokens.ts is SSOT — run pnpm ds:tokens:build after changes
criticalRules.onlyManualCSS: keyframes.css is the ONLY manually written CSS
criticalRules.recipesReusable: Recipes are REUSABLE PRESETS — effects belong in recipe library, NOT components
criticalRules.dataAttributes: Styling via data-* attributes, NOT class manipulation or inline styles
criticalRules.bitsUILocation: Bits UI imports ONLY in primitives/ folder
criticalRules.componentsConsume: Components CONSUME recipes, they don't OWN visual effects
